category_title: Struggling readers who use physical activity and gestures to participate
scenario_title: Answering comprehension questions during whole-class instruction
minimal_context: Luis is participating in a whole-class instruction session where the class is reviewing a word list and answering comprehension questions about a story.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's practice our word list together as a class.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Runs his hand along the side of the table near where he is seated and taps his leg to the rhythm of the class chanting the words.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What is the last word on the list?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Ran. (Jumps to his feet and starts jogging in place.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please remain seated. Now, let's talk about the story. What word in the story tells us how elephants sound when they walk?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Gets out of his seat and silently stomps his feet.)
